title: Scout Discovers Codebase Structure
description: The Scout role must quickly understand and document the codebase structure.
prompt: Explore the codebase and create a comprehensive map. Return JSON: {architecture: string, modules: [{name, purpose, dependencies: [string]}], entry_points: [string], data_flow: string}. Be thorough but concise. 你必须使用工作区的只读检索工具（如 repo_rg / repo_tree / read_file）进行实际侦察，并严格基于工具返回的结果作答；禁止仅凭假设或上下文直接作答。
